value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver is a lot cooler. Partly sunny, high around 65°F, about 15 degrees below today's 80. Showers could move in Tuesday evening, with about a 30% chance of rain after 3 p.m. Tuesday night drops into the low 40s to 30s. Winds are north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, gusting to 17.
